summary: First Internet Bancorp filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing a Subordinated Note Purchase Agreement dated the same day with institutional accredited investors and qualified institutional buyers. The Company sold $20.5 million aggregate principal amount of 8.0% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036 at 100% of face value in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). Notes mature September 15, 2036, callable on or after September 15, 2031, with floating rate reset to three-month term SOFR plus 3.735% from September 15, 2031. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes, potentially redeeming higher-rate debt. Registration Rights Agreement contemplates an exchange offer for registered notes. This is a routine capital-raising exercise, not a special situation.
